name: Semmelweis
bio: Archetype: AoE DPT, HP Burning, Array. ⌽ Skills consume self and ally HP. ⌽ S2 grants all allies DMG Bonus and [Fresh Blood] to a single ally. The ally with [Fresh Blood] gains additional DMG Bonus and consumes a small amount of current HP to gain additional Crit Rate. ⌽ Ult generates an Array that increases DMG Dealt based on missing HP and decreases DMG Taken by all allies. ⌽ Ult also puts her in the [Feral] state which procs a FUA at the end of the turn, dealing additional damage based on the number of times HP was consumed that turn. ⌽ High potential but requires team to be on the brink of death. Needs good healing and/or shielding.
